text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day before the Satsuki Sho―― A petite, 
red-haired girl about the same size as 
Narita Taishin appeared before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Nobody expects anything from you." 
"Nobody thinks you can win." "Don't you 
ever feel like giving up?"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In response to the girl's question, Narita 
Taishin asserted, "That's no reason to 
give up. I'll prove everyone wrong with my 
own running."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The following day, as if to back up her 
words, Narita Taishin stepped up to race 
with an intensity that utterly overwhelmed 
her two rivals.
